scenes.text: Claude built it in four phases, one prompt each. Commission tiers work like tax brackets, and every rep gets a statement that shows the math, deal by deal, tier by tier.
But the useful part is what broke. Sign-in matched people by email, but people had no email field. And recalculating an approved month left out a deal cancelled after approval.
QuotaPath Growth is thirty-five dollars per user per month, plus a platform fee. If you have a few reps on one or two plans, you mostly need the tiers, the statements, and a month that stays locked.
